summary: Completed testing of 6 bug fixes/features for Vessel/Crew Safety Management System. All features working correctly: Incidents sort dropdown, Document filters, Trip hyperlink in shift view, Crew URL params handling, DateTimeInput Now button, and Vessels API deduplication.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 features from this batch are working: 1) Incidents sort dropdown with 5 options (Date Newest/Oldest, Name A-Z/Z-A, Severity), 2) Document Management filters (category, vessel, sort by name/date/category), 3) Trip hyperlink in shift log view (data-testid='shift-trip-hyperlink'), 4) Crew Management URL params handling (/crew?edit_id=xxx opens edit dialog), 5) DateTimeInput Now button (clock icon) visible in shift log forms, 6) Vessels API returns deduplicated list. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_api_endpoints.py cover auth, vessels, incidents, documents, crew, trips APIs.

incidents_sort_dropdown.details: Sort dropdown visible with data-testid='incident-sort-select'. Options: Date (Newest), Date (Oldest), Name (A-Z), Name (Z-A), Severity. Sorting changes incident order correctly.

document_management_filters.details: Category filter, vessel filter, and sort by dropdown all working. Sort options include Name (A-Z) and Category.

trip_hyperlink_in_shift_view.details: Trip name hyperlink visible in shift log view with data-testid='shift-trip-hyperlink'. Opens trip page in new tab.

crew_url_params_handling.details: Navigating to /crew?edit_id=xxx automatically opens the edit dialog for that crew member.

datetime_input_now_button.details: Clock icon (Now button) visible next to datetime inputs in shift log form. Found 2 clock buttons for Shift Start and Shift Stop fields.

vessels_api_deduplication.details: Backend test verified vessels endpoint returns unique vessel IDs with no duplicates.

manage_in_crew_button.details: Button visible in crew details dialog Training view. Navigates to crew management page.
